# data.docker_container_file

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads a path inside a container: its stat (name, size, mode, mtime, link target) and, for a regular file, its content as base64. It uses the Engine archive API (`HEAD` and `GET /containers/{id}/archive`), like `docker container cp CONTAINER:PATH -`, and works on stopped containers too. For a directory or symlink only `stat` is filled and `content_base64` is null. Files larger than 32 MiB are an error. Decode the content with `base64decode()` (UTF-8 text) or pass it on as is.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `container` | `string` | required |  |  | The container to read, by ID or name. |
| `container_id` | `string` | computed |  |  | ID of the container the file was read from. |
| `content_base64` | `string` | computed |  | yes | The file content (single regular file extracted from the GET /containers/{id}/archive tar), base64-encoded. |
| `content_base64_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | sha256 of content_base64. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version from GET /version. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion). |
| `path` | `string` | required |  |  | Absolute path inside the container, e.g. `/etc/nginx/nginx.conf`. |
| `stat` | `object` | computed |  |  | The path stat as a nested object. Keys come from the base64 JSON in the header (moby container.PathStat); swagger documents the header but not its keys. |
| `stat_json` | `string` | computed |  |  | The decoded X-Docker-Container-Path-Stat header (HEAD /containers/{id}/archive) as JSON. |
| `stat_json_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | sha256 of stat_json. |

### `stat`

nested attribute, object. The path stat as a nested object. Keys come from the base64 JSON in the header (moby container.PathStat); swagger documents the header but not its keys.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `link_target` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `linkTarget`. |
| `mode` | `number` | computed |  |  | Upstream `mode`. |
| `mtime` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `mtime`. |
| `name` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `name`. |
| `size` | `number` | computed |  |  | Upstream `size`. |

## Example

```terraform
# Read a configuration file a container generated on first start.
data "docker_container_file" "generated" {
  container = "app"
  path      = "/var/lib/app/generated.conf"
}

output "generated_conf" {
  value     = base64decode(data.docker_container_file.generated.content_base64)
  sensitive = true
}

output "generated_conf_size" {
  value = data.docker_container_file.generated.stat.size
}
```
